narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional food vlog aimed at recommending '2infinite', a Western-style brunch restaurant in Kaohsiung. It highlights the chef's professional background and commitment to handmade sauces to build trust in food quality, while using high-quality close-ups of juicy burgers and steaks to stimulate appetite. The inclusion of interior shots positions the venue as a social-friendly spot.
